description: Lead formatter: cleans a list of contact records you supply (name, company, email, phone, website) into one consistent shape: trims spaces, fixes casing of names, lowercases emails and domains, keeps digits of phone numbers, and flags invalid emails. It adds no outside data. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

records.description: Up to 50 objects with optional name, company, email, phone, website strings
